sentences.text: Taiwan -LRB- -LSB- taɪˈwɑːn -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Republic of China -LRB- ROC -RRB- , is a state in East Asia .	Taiwan	Island of Taiwan	East Asia	East Asia	China	China	Republic of China	Republic of China (1912–49)
